method: Conservative full-text review requiring the Sermon on the Mount or one of its defining sections to be a primary or major sustained subject of each post.

topic.name: Sermon on the Mount
topic.description: Examines Matthew's Sermon on the Mount, including its composition, relationship to Luke's Sermon on the Plain, the Beatitudes, the Golden Rule, and its interpretation of Jewish law and ethics.
